create_android_env_config: create an AndroidEnvConfig with custom task, coordinator, and emulator simulator settings
configure_emulator_launcher: configure an EmulatorLauncherConfig with a custom AVD name, GPU mode, and headless mode
set_adb_controller_config: set an AdbControllerConfig with a custom adb path, server port, and device name
configure_coordinator: configure a CoordinatorConfig with multiple virtual fingers and periodic restart time
use_gpu_mode_enum: use the GPUMode enum to select host, swangle_indirect, or swiftshader_indirect GPU rendering
